Hence, the other circle will be passing through the centre of the first circle.

Hence, the required equation of circle is x-0x-3+y-0y--2=0

⇒x2+y2-3x+2y=0

Put α,12 in the above equation⇒α2+14-3α+1=0
⇒α2-3α+54=0
⇒4α2-12α+5=0

⇒4α2-10α-2α+5=0
